item.text: {"iteration":2,"pcvs":[{"name":"running_requests","expression":"len(self.running)","rationale":"Models the repeated decode scheduling and cached-request output work."},{"name":"waiting_requests","expression":"len(self.waiting) + len(self.skipped_waiting)","rationale":"Models per-request admission and new-request output work."},{"name":"has_waiting_requests","expression":"int(bool(self.waiting or self.skipped_waiting))","rationale":"Allows admission steps to have a different fixed cost from decode-only steps."},{"name":"waiting_prompt_tokens","expression":"sum(r.num_tokens for r in self.waiting)","rationale":"Captures prompt-dependent admission costs hidden by block counts, which were identical to waiting request counts in every measured state."}],"hypothesis":"Admission and decode require different fixed costs, while admission cost also depends on prompt length. Replacing the two uninformative block features with an admission indicator and prompt-token total should explain substantially more variation."}
